description: ADO-BATCH constraint failures across two client batch-optimistic Recordsets (read/write copy): one on Ch (ID, PID, S) with an inserted orphan (ID 9, PID 99) and S of row 1 changed, one on P (ID, Nm) with Delete of the referenced row 1 and Nm of row 3 changed; UpdateBatch(adAffectAll) on the Ch Recordset (Errors, each row's Status, stored Ch rows), then on the P Recordset (Errors, Status, stored P rows), then Filter = adFilterConflictingRecords RecordCount of each. Asks which staged changes reach the file, the failing row's Status and the error set.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
